descriptor: Furniture and design studio, built to be mended

voice.summary: Hollow Oak speaks like a carpenter reading a creed aloud: short declarative lines, warm and a little stubborn. It trusts plain words about wood, repair and time over any design-world gloss.
dos: State beliefs as short sentences a person could say at a workbench
Name the material, the joint or the tool instead of the idea
Let a line end early and leave room for the reader
donts: Promise perfection when we mean repairable
Shout, since the type is already big

taglines: Build it so someone can mend it
Oak, patience and a good joint
boilerplate: Hollow Oak Studio is an independent furniture and design workshop that makes pieces to be repaired, passed on and lived with, guided by ten written beliefs about craft.

microcopy.success: Line received. We will be in touch.
microcopy.error: That did not go through. Try once more.

logo.note: A young shoot on an oak nods to the growing tree on the page and to furniture that outlives its maker.
